tools.name: rewardful_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the affiliate program's campaigns with their reward rules (percent or fixed commission, payout minimum, referral expiry) and totals (visitors, leads, conversions, affiliates). Rewardful: GET /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: rewardful_get_campaign
tools.description: Fetch a single campaign by id. Rewardful: GET /v1/campaigns/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_affiliates
tools.description: List affiliates, newest first, with visitors/leads/conversions. Filter by campaign, or look one up by email or Stripe customer id (returns zero or one). Expand campaign, links or commission_stats for more detail. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliates.

tools.name: rewardful_get_affiliate
tools.description: Fetch a single affiliate by id, including their campaign, links, coupon and visitor/lead/conversion counts. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliates/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_affiliate_links
tools.description: List affiliate links (URL, token, visitors, leads, conversions, affiliate_id), newest first. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_links.

tools.name: rewardful_get_affiliate_link
tools.description: Fetch a single affiliate link by id. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_links/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_affiliate_coupons
tools.description: List affiliate coupon / promotion codes (token, Stripe id, leads, conversions, archived), optionally for one affiliate. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_coupons.

tools.name: rewardful_get_affiliate_coupon
tools.description: Fetch a single affiliate coupon by id. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_coupons/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_referrals
tools.description: List referrals — visitors who arrived via an affiliate link — newest first, with their conversion state (visitor, lead, conversion), customer and link. Filter by affiliate, state, email, Stripe customer or an updated-at window. Rewardful: GET /v1/referrals.

tools.name: rewardful_list_commissions
tools.description: List commissions (rewards owed for referred customers' payments) newest first, with amount in cents, currency and state (pending, due, paid, voided). Filter by affiliate or state; expand the sale (with referral, customer and affiliate) or campaign. Rewardful: GET /v1/commissions.

tools.name: rewardful_get_commission
tools.description: Fetch a single commission by id, with its campaign and the sale (charge, refund and tax amounts, referral, customer, affiliate) that earned it. Rewardful: GET /v1/commissions/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_payouts
tools.description: List payouts — bundles of an affiliate's payable commissions — newest first, with amount, currency and state (pending, due, processing, paid). Filter by affiliate or state; expand affiliate or commissions. Rewardful: GET /v1/payouts.

tools.name: rewardful_get_payout
tools.description: Fetch a single payout by id, with the affiliate and the commissions it bundles. Rewardful: GET /v1/payouts/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_campaign
tools.description: Create a new affiliate campaign with its reward rule. For reward_type percent pass commission_percent; for amount pass commission_amount_cents and commission_amount_currency. Rewardful: POST /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: rewardful_update_campaign
tools.description: Change a campaign's name, URL, visibility, reward rule, payout minimum or coupon. Only the fields you pass change. Rewardful: PUT /v1/campaigns/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_affiliate
tools.description: Add an affiliate (or a customer referrer, by passing stripe_customer_id). Rewardful sends NO welcome email for API-created affiliates. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliates.

tools.name: rewardful_update_affiliate
tools.description: Change an affiliate's name, email, payout emails, notifications, campaign (moves them) or state. Setting state to disabled stops tracking and earning; set it back to active to undo. Rewardful: PUT /v1/affiliates/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_affiliate_link
tools.description: Give an affiliate an additional tracking link. A token is generated if omitted. Growth/Enterprise plans only. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliate_links.

tools.name: rewardful_update_affiliate_link
tools.description: Change the token of an existing affiliate link. WARNING: the old token stops tracking immediately — links already shared with it break. Prefer rewardful_create_affiliate_link to add a second token. Rewardful: PUT /v1/affiliate_links/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_affiliate_coupon
tools.description: Assign a coupon / promotion code to an affiliate so sales using it are credited to them. The code must match one defined in Stripe, and the affiliate's campaign must have a campaign coupon set in the dashboard. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliate_coupons.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "rewardful_update_affiliate_link" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rewardful_list_affiliates, rewardful_list_affiliate_links, rewardful_list_referrals · Private data: rewardful_list_affiliate_links, rewardful_list_affiliate_coupons, rewardful_create_affiliate_link, rewardful_update_affiliate_link · Public sink: rewardful_list_affiliates, rewardful_list_referrals, rewardful_create_campaign, rewardful_create_affiliate, rewardful_update_affiliate, rewardful_create_affiliate_link, rewardful_create_affiliate_coupon.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rewardful_list_affiliates, rewardful_list_affiliate_links, rewardful_list_referrals · Private data: rewardful_list_affiliate_links, rewardful_list_affiliate_coupons, rewardful_create_affiliate_link, rewardful_update_affiliate_link · Public sink: rewardful_list_affiliates, rewardful_list_referrals, rewardful_create_campaign, rewardful_create_affiliate, rewardful_update_affiliate, rewardful_create_affiliate_link, rewardful_create_affiliate_coupon

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
